verdict.rationale: Meltano documents scheduled pipelines 'orchestrated using Apache Airflow' (meltano-docs-7), meaning dependency/ordering logic is delegated to an external orchestrator rather than a native dependency-graph engine within Meltano itself; plugins (extractors/loaders/transformers) are defined in a project but no evidence shows a built-in DAG or dependency-declaration mechanism between steps/datasets.  missing for 10: native dependency-graph/DAG definition inside Meltano, evidence of ordering datasets by dependency without Airflow, hands-on confirmation of orchestration correctness.
